title: Core Integrated Desktop/Mobile Golden Comic Proof
objective: Prove the original core sequential-art authoring path end to end across desktop/mobile before professional/collaborative extension: imported/user-owned, native and generated assets; Character actors; map/tile background; dialogue; derivative registration; rights filtering; accessibility projection; save/recovery and static export.
acceptance: A deterministic golden comic scenario exercises the sealed SAA-01..19 core path across desktop and mobile validation surfaces without introducing new canonical authority.
The proof covers imported/user-owned, native and generated governed resources through existing ARI boundaries, Character actors, map/tile background projection and dialogue binding.
The proof covers composition-to-ARI derivative handoff, rights filtering, reversible history/save/recovery, accessibility projection and static image/multipage export.
Desktop and mobile projections preserve the same governed project/page/panel identities, reading order, owner/source references and deterministic expected outcomes.
Optional SAA-16 audio and SAA-19 advisory assistance remain optional and cannot be required for the core visual golden proof.
Any missing, stale, unavailable, incompatible or rights-prohibited source fails the governed proof case closed rather than being silently repaired or substituted.
SAA-20 is a core milestone only; SAA-21 and later professional/collaborative extensions remain unauthorized until verified closeout.
boundaries: SAA-01..19 predecessor contracts remain sealed and are consumed as existing authority surfaces; SAA-20 does not redesign their contracts.
Golden-proof fixtures may compose sealed contracts but may not create duplicate Character, Scene, Dialogue, ARI, AAI, narrative or SAA authority ledgers.
Desktop/mobile proof parity must be deterministic and repository-local where possible, with no paid cloud/provider dependency.
The proof does not authorize collaboration, advanced lettering/drawing, sharing/publication, external upload or final terminal SAA closure.
SAA-21 remains blocked until verified SAA-20 closeout.
next_action: SAA-20 is completed_verified. SAA-21 — Real-Time Collaboration, Review & Multi-Device Sync — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
